t: You're at the site of St Mildred, Poultry, a parish church in the Cheap ward of the City. It was dedicated to the Anglo-Saxon Saint Mildred, and it was rebuilt after the Great Fire of London. It was demolished in 1872, so the church itself is gone. The writer Thomas Tusser was buried here, and John Stow described the church and its monuments in his Survey of London. So was John Williams, who became Bishop of Chichester and died in 1709.
